Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The v0 gates and S0-S9/S11 harness implementation are on main. Current comparison tests pass (473 JVM/242 JS), with one opt-in AR-heavy skip; no sealed pilot was run or inspected. S10 runner/ScoreFeed/owner reader/freeze/rehearsal remains the explicit gap.

Fresh context: Yes: protocol / pilot readiness.

Next action: Refresh the protocol's bound source, runtime locks, charged ML work and custody handoff; implement and independently rehearse S10 on synthetic data before any owner campaign decision. Preserve consumed-seed and cost limits.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; docs/plans/phrf-pilot-custody-runbook.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Owner directive (2026-09-30, relayed on Fray #69): "make sure PHRF substantially achieves what it set out to do and we have proof, comparisons with other approaches, etc. as this is a new method we have a high bar."

The orchestrator authorised this on Fray #69 at seq 753 (exec-orchestrator). The deliverable is a concrete, bounded comparison protocol document with projected costs, for independent review before the owner decides on any compute campaign or dataset. Out of scope: code, data acquisition, campaign execution, new seeds.

Constraints from the orchestrator:
- Target. The current qualified ProfileHrf numeric source is 327eda76792bcb0e542cb9e9c6f0d1351f45b1ea. The private integration source 8d5b0e5152240819152a434b11af4be1095cee60 has later core workflow changes. Any final experiment binds to its actual source, provider and runtime closure.
- Seeds. Every response or seed already examined is development or prior evidence and is never fresh confirmation. Seeds 7000930201, 7000930102 and 7000930103 are consumed. No new seeds are allocated.
- Comparators. Match estimands, units and normalization first.
  - Condition comparators: fixed canonical GLM, informed basis, FIR.
  - Distinct trial comparisons: LSA/LSS and a properly attributed GLMsingle. A reimplementation inspired by GLMsingle is never labelled equivalent without independent parity.
- Pre-specify tuning and hyperparameter selection, missing or refused fits, paired uncertainty and multiplicity. Retain failed attempts, and never select cells by looking at results.
- Misspecified families, overlap, known versus estimated whitening, and singletons each need explicit scientific admission; outputs are not pooled automatically. The unavailable original-family trial certificate is reported as a limit.
- Keep four things separate: numerical oracle correctness, scientific calibration, practitioner comparisons, and resources. Advantage is a claim to be tested, not a result to force.

Deliverable: docs/plans/phrf-comparative-evaluation-protocol.md, plus an independent review.
